manifest.name: Skyloom
manifest.description: A voice-first party game: one player describes a hidden constellation out loud, everyone else moves a star on a shared night sky.
dialog.title: Skyloom
card.invite: {{name}} opened a night of Skyloom. Describe a hidden constellation, or move a star to match it.
card.round-gold: Round {{round}}, described by {{name}}: {{res}}% resonance, woven in gold thread
card.round-woven: Round {{round}}, described by {{name}}: {{res}}% resonance, woven into the sky
card.round-loose: Round {{round}}, described by {{name}}: {{res}}% resonance, the threads came loose
say.results: The night is over. Team resonance {{res}} percent.
page.title: Skyloom
page.twist.fog-hint: Fog: you only see stars near your own.
page.twist.mirror-hint: Mirror: your sky card is flipped. Describe the figure the other way round.
page.twist.drift-hint: Drift: one star slowly drifts away. Hold it in place.
page.twist.twin-hint: Twin Weavers: you see half of the figure.
page.hud.join-next: You get a star next round.
page.seal.title: The sky is being sealed
page.dawn.title: Dawn. The threads are pulled tight…
page.verify.seal-broken: Unverified: the figure did not match the seal
page.verify.missing: Unverified: this client missed part of the round
page.next.night-over: Waiting for {{name}} to show the tapestry…
page.void.title: Clouds roll in
page.void.weaver-left: The Weaver left. The night goes on with the next Weaver.
page.void.stalled: The round stalled. The night goes on with the next Weaver.
page.void.too-few: Too few stars to weave this round.
page.void.unverified: The figure could not be checked this round.
page.void.no-random: No randomness was available this round.
page.rules.title: How to play Skyloom
page.rules.1: Each round one player is the Weaver. Only they see the constellation, and they may only talk: no typing, no pointing.
page.rules.2: Everyone else is a Threader with one star (with few players, several). Drag it, or use the arrow keys; Shift moves in fine steps.
page.rules.3: Position and size do not matter, only the shape. Up still means up.
page.rules.4: The Weaver can pluck a star (number keys) so everyone sees which one is meant, and can tie off early for a small bonus.
page.rules.5: At dawn the stars lock. 60% resonance weaves the constellation into the sky, 90% weaves it in gold.
page.rules.6: One round per player, at most 8. It is a team game: the score is everyone's.

page.loom.label: The loom: a night sky with the players' stars
page.card.label: Sky card: {{figure}}
page.lobby.tagline: One voice sees the constellation. Everyone else is a star.
page.lobby.how-text: each round one Weaver sees a hidden constellation and describes it out loud. Everyone else moves one star. When dawn breaks, the threads are pulled tight. How close did you get?
page.lobby.waiting-light: You're in · waiting for {{name}} to light the loom
page.lobby.skies-hint: Mixed adds a twist from round 3: Fog, Mirror, Drift or Twin Weavers.
page.lobby.rounds: Rounds: one per player, at most 8 · about {{mins}} minutes
page.hud.tip-a: Tip: plucking a star makes it ripple, so
page.card.rule: Describe it with your voice only: no typing, no pointing. Size and position on the loom don't matter, the shape does.
page.guess.title: Your guess (just for fun)
page.guess.hint: A bird? A teapot? Type it and see at dawn.
page.watch.title: You're watching round {{no}}
page.watch.text: You get a star when the next round starts. The figure stays hidden until dawn, so you can guess along.
page.verify.ok-detail: figure matched {{name}}'s seal, every score agrees
page.results.silver-detail: {{figure}}, {{res}}%: the best weave of the night
page.results.truest-detail: Closest to their place in {{n}} of {{of}} rounds
